grf.generated_reality: A content-matching SQLite runtime anchor is sufficient evidence for productive runtime admission.
grf.counter_reality: A matching anchor whose file or ancestor path is symlinked, non-root-owned, or group/other-writable can be mutable by a weaker authority and therefore cannot act as an independent deployment trust anchor.
grf.falsifier: Transpose ownership/path-writability while holding anchor content and runtime identity constant.
